input.summary:
Full source-fidelity preflight completed against input/disclosure.md and input/conversation.md (the USER passages), with input/brief.md used only for formalities (title, applicant/inventor Nimo Rotem, no priority claim, no federal support, apparatus+method classes, no means-plus-function). I traced a complete ledger: all 16 claims (1-10 apparatus, 11-16 method) limitation by limitation; all 28 numerals in draft/numerals.md (100, 102, 104, 106, 108, 110, 112, 114, 116, 118, 120, 122, 124, 126, 128, 130, 132, 134, 140, 202-216); every structure, relationship, threshold, condition, sequence and asserted result in the Summary, Detailed Description and Abstract; and all four figure briefs plus the Brief Description of the Drawings.

Every limitation maps to an exact affirmative disclosure passage: branch limit lower than the sum of connector ratings; per-connector contactor, connector current sensor, control-pilot interface and local connector identifier; branch current sensor measuring total current "upstream of the connector contactors" as an "independent safety input"; isolated local bus to the connector interfaces and contactors; stored charging authorization, requested current, minimum sustaining current and energy-deficit value; per-interval subtraction of measured non-charging branch load and a configurable safety reserve from the branch limit; minimum-sustaining-first then deficit-weighted remainder; assigned limits sent through the control-pilot interface and verified with the corresponding connector current sensor; reduced pilot command, verification interval, then one-at-a-time opening in a stored shedding order "until measured branch current is below the branch limit" (which supports claims 2/12 re-measurement and stop condition); the three reclosure conditions of claims 3/13; the leakage-threshold welded-contactor record, inhibition of the other contactors on the same branch and local fault indicator of claims 4/14; network interface, signed local authorization token and last accepted branch limit in nonvolatile memory, outage continuation, no new session without a valid unexpired token, and tamper-evident meter records uploaded on return (claims 6-8, 15); and the service-input mapping by one low-energy pilot transition at a time with storage only after the sensed channel agrees (claims 9, 10, 16). Stated advantages (bounded shedding, non-simultaneous restoration, outage service preservation, complete accounting, detection of a transposed wiring map) each restate a disclosed behavior or the disclosure's own "prevents a wiring-map error" statement.

Figure briefs were checked for verbalized geometry that would assert undisclosed technical substance. The generic outlines (dashed installation and channel boundaries, square sensor outlines, empty blocks, rounded vehicle outline, flowchart rectangles/diamond/terminator) are shape-neutral depiction conventions carried only in the figure briefs; no "by way of example", "any closed outline", or shape-justifying language appears anywhere in the application text. The topology statements that do carry substance all trace: branch sensor upstream of every connector-channel drop and of the non-charging load follows from "measures total current upstream of the connector contactors" combined with subtraction of a "measured non-charging branch load"; the connector current sensor downstream of the contactor follows from the zero-current reclosure condition and post-open leakage detection; bus branches to the contactor and control-pilot interface only (not to the non-charging load) follow from "communicates with the connector interfaces and contactors over an isolated local bus"; the fault indicator external to and operated by the controller follows from "operates a local fault indicator". Numerals 132 and 134 are the controller's own executing and storing elements as disclosed ("the controller stores, for each active connector, ...") and add no relationship beyond the controller's disclosed functions.

Internal consistency: claims, Summary, Detailed Description and Abstract use one term set ("connector channel", "assigned current limit", "stored shedding order", "verification interval", "leakage threshold", "signed local authorization token", "last accepted branch limit"); each numeral has exactly one referent and each appears in at least one figure brief; FIG. 4 has eight shapes for eight step numerals 202-216 in the order the description recites, with the below-limit return to 202 and the post-reclosure return to 202 matching the text and the welded-condition terminator matching "reached where no welded-contactor condition has been recorded"; no section views or section lines exist, so no designation matching applies; the abstract is 146 words and single-paragraph. No drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains. No untraced technical assertion and no verified inconsistency was found, so the findings array is empty.
